alt: The blue train crossing the Nine Arches Bridge near Ella

expert.name: Aditya
expert.role: Sri Lanka expert at Hi Tours
expert.quote: Kandy, the hills and then the coast. Sri Lanka works best when you let the island cool you down before it warms you up again.
expert.tip: Carry a light sweater for Nuwara Eliya. It sits at nearly 1,900 metres and evenings are surprisingly chilly even in April.

summary: Seven days with the best train ride in Asia in the middle: a first night in Colombo, two in Kandy with Sigiriya and the dance show, the hill train to Ella and its bridge, a night at Galle after Mirissa beach, and a final night in the capital.
included: Included: 6 nights in standard and deluxe class hotels with breakfast and lunch or dinner daily (breakfast only in Galle); private airport transfers and all road travel in an air conditioned car with chauffeur guide; the Kandy to Ella train tickets; a private Pinnawala visit; a private lake drive and Kandyan dance show; a private excursion to Sigiriya; the Ella sightseeing tour; the Mirissa and Galle excursion; full day Colombo sightseeing.
not_included: Not included: international flights; Sri Lanka ETA visa fees; lunches unless stated; entrance tickets where marked as payable locally; travel insurance; optional excursions; tips and personal expenses.
